verdict.rationale: Sprinto exposes APIs (custom integration push APIs and framework health/vendor data APIs), so scoped API credentials are a fair question for this product. However, no evidence describes issuing API keys or tokens, permission scopes, or least-privilege credentials for an agent. Webhook endpoint URLs and role checks on integrated third-party systems are adjacent features, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
